tei:div.tei:p: 3 —ju—— — cu jinene+eceXshe—byewag wawadwo/byedi rme— — // — tresnyezehewaXrikardzitwechonorjo kyi ri gyiX —wa — —mi ko——gar+sha—ga4 —༷dzha wa dzi trī ’kyigidhewa ——/4 ci— ༷nochi—〉 — rka rtswa / 3 ram̐ 7 zlormidzo ṣ+ṭi8 wangh+rustsedī3/—dudi— cija rdzo 4hūṃdz+ra /rngo+ongh+ruXci7—nyanelcesku da —3 sgyu spyo —lha/ shertsi ausgyu sab po pa glusirtse 4gyi no— mi4ba saso ༈ tsosapa nyi wīm gyisatshoms/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying sto wīg khang nas tshwags/ bod ljongasami dmangs dpe skrun khang /

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang gi dpe tshogs bsdu sgrig las mi'i mtshan tho/ spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma dang /'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig 'gan khur ba gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ kame bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig pa/ thub bstan 'od zer/ zla ba bstan 'dzin/ dpyid sa dpal bzang / dkon mchog bsam gtan/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag pa/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ thub bstan nyi ma/ karma bde legs/ dkon mchog bsam gtan/rgyab shog bzo skrun jus 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje dang / lag rtsal pa/ ye shes chos mtsho/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ ye shes chos mtsho/ byams pa chos sgron/bstan 'dzin/bsod nams tshe sgron sogs dpal brtsegs glog klad las byed pa rnams/

dpe skrun gsal bshad/rang re'i mes po mkhas dbang dam pa rim byon gyi rnam dpyod lto ba yangs pa'i rtsal las rab tu 'brungs pa'i gtsug lag ni nam mkha'i mtha' ltar mnyam la ri rab lhun po'i dpangs las mtho ba/ rgya mtsho chen po'i 'jings bzhin zab pa bcas 'dzam gling skye 'gro kun gyi mthong chos su gyur cing / de dag ni rang rigs kyi rin thang gzhal du med pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yin la/ mes rgyal shes rig bang mdzod nang gi gzi spyin 'od snang 'phro ba'i gces nor yin pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling shes rig bang mdzod chen mo'i khrod kyi ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchog nor yang yin/ 'on kyang de dag mi lo brgya phrag stong phrag nang mi dang rang byung gis 'tshe bas rkyen pas nyams brlag tu phyin dang 'gro la khad du thug cing / de dag gi nang don kha cig yul dang dus kyis bskal bas shin tu rtogs dka' bar gyur te/ dus phyis zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi bya rgyur 'gog rkyen 'phrad kyi yod/ bod du bcings 'grol btang rjes dang lhag par du tang gi skabasabacu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshun/ tang dang rgyal khab nas mi shugs dang rgyu stobs kyi mthun rkyen bzang po sbyar te shul du lus pa'i gtsug lag mang dag cig myur skyob dang / 'tshol bsdu/ legs sgrig /par skrun bcas mdzad de sdi~X 'bras mi dman pa thob dang 'thob

dpe skrun gsal bshad/bzhin pa lags/ 'on kyang bya ba 'di ni rgya che zhid zhib tshags pa dang /gting dpog dka' ba'i las gzhi rlabs po che zhig yin gshis/ mdun skyod kyi lam bu kyag kyog kyang kyong dang / tha na tsher ma'i tshang tshing gis yongs su gtums pa'ang 'byung srid pas rang re'i srid gzhung dang / 'brel yod sde tshan/ mnyam sdeb/ spyi dmangs mi sger bcas kyis mnyam las phyar ba gru 'degs dang / blo rtse zong kha gcig sgril/ thabs shes yod dgu rtsal sprug bcas kyis rang ngos nas 'go brtsams pa dang bya ba'i sne mo re re bzhin snying rus chen pos rgyun bskyangs nas bsgrubs tshe/ dka' tshegs mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal te byas rjes drud shul thon pa zhig yong thub snyam/ da phan mi lo bcu grangs nang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis rnam par dag pa'i lhag bsam dang ngal ba khur bzod kyi snying stobs la brten nas 'bad 'bungs lhur len gyis bod kyi sa gnas grong khyer dang / rdzong dang shang / tha na mtha' 'khob lung khug gi grong tsho dang 'brog dgon sogs gang sar phebs nas de khul du shin tu nyag phra zhing thar thor du lus pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon mang dag cig myur skyob 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun mdzad pa kun gyis mig mthong lag zin byung bas snying khams dbus nas dad gus dang rjes su yi rang zhu rgyu yin/ bod mi rigs kyi phul du byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas shul bzhag 'tshol bsdu dang / legs sgrig /dpe skrun bcas byas te deng gi spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs dang / phyi rabs rgyud bcas rnams la skyes su 'bul rgyu'i dmigs yul dang / dgos pa/ phan rlabs —2—

dpe skrun gsal bshad/bcas la blo kha gcig mthun thog da lam dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / 'di ga bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib 'jug gros mol thengs mang byas mthar/ khong rnam pas 'tshol bsdu legs sgrig mdzad pa'i gsung rab dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen khag nged dpe skrun khang gis rim bzhin dpe skrun bya gtan khel ba bzhin/ da lan mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs khongs kyi 〈rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa 〉 zhes bya ba 'di deb lnga par brtsis nas dpe skrun zhus pa yin zhing / dpe deb 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad zhib tshags nan tur byas khul lags kyang da dung skyon cha mi nyung ba zhig yod srid stabs/mkhyen dpyod yangs pa'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis nor bcos kyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ mkhyen/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bstan rgyas kyis/

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigade yang 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes/ phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa dang 'tshams shing / thar 'dod skye bo yongs kyi 'jug ngogs dam par gyur pa'i/ chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa yang lta ba rten 'byung dang / spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid yin la/ de yang gtad rabs bdun dang / shing rta chen po gnyis la sogs pa las/ rim par 'dzam gling gi tha gru kun tu khyab pa las/ rang cag gangs can par mtshon na/ mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid chen po mes po bka' drin can rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi 'od snang / phyi rabs 'gro ba'i lam ston sgron me lta bu'i bstan bcos sa chen po'i rdul ltar/ grangs tsam yang bsgrangs par dka' ba ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ deng dus spyi tshogs la dgos gal che ba khag cig mkho btus kyis/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di nyid/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang dang / nga tsho'i dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gnyis mnyam las kyis rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du rim pa bstar chags su 'bul rgyu yin/de yang da lta'i char phyi dngos po'i 'phel 'gyur dang / nang bsam pa'i shes tshad cha mi snyoms pa'i dus radisna kyi skyogs mtshams 'dir / smra shes

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigashing don go ba 'gro ba mi'i rigs spyi dang / khyad par du spyi tshogs la 'gan khur gyi bsam blo ldan pa'i shes yon can rnams kyis/ bsam blo gu yangs dang /mig rgyang ring po'i sgo nas bsam blo'i langs phyogs ma nor bar legs nyes kyi gnas la bsam gzhig dang / spyi tshogs la rang nus kyis 'gan khur dang zhabs zhu gang 'grub byas nas/ 'cham mthun brtan brling dang shes dpal ldan pa'i 'khor yug cig 'dzugs skrun byed pa ni/ rang cag skye bo kun gyi phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin snyam/de yang nged zhib 'jug khang gi lo ngo bcu phrag lhag tsam gyi ring / gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og /mdo dbus khams gsum gyi sa gnas so sor dngos su bskyod cing / dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams srung skyob dang / 'tshol bsdu/ nyams gso sogs kyi las ka'i brgyud rim nang / gal che'i dpe dkon mang po zhig rnyed son byung ba rnams/bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs bsgrig dang / bka' gdams gsung 'bum gces btus/ mes po'i shul bzhag /phyag bris gces btus/ shes bya'i gter bum/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs kyi dpe tshogs rnams so sor bsdu bsgrigs dang par bskrun zhus dang zhu bzhin pa las/ da lam mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di yang / ji skad du/ 'jug pa las/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pas chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed cig gsung pa'i snying po/ mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin de nyid thos bsam sgom —2—

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigapa'i shes rab kyis rang rgyud la skye dgos pa yin la/ de lta bu'i thos bsam bya yul gyi gzhung lugs ni/ 'chos skyob yon tan gnyis ldan gyi bka' dang /bstan bcos rnam dag la rag las pas/ 'dir yang brjod bya gtso bo deng dus kyi spyi tshogs la dgos gal che zhing bsam blo'i slob gso la med du mi rung ba byang chub sems kyi bslab bya dang 'brel ba'i zab chos du ma dang / dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi rin thang ldan pa/ yig tshogs nyung zhing blta bde ba/ grub mtha' phyogs su ma lhung ba/ spyi tshogs dza drag dang rnyog 'dzing sogs kyis yid sems nyams nyes su gyur tshe/ blta klog byas na blo rnal du dbab pa sogs dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa dang / rin thang ldan pa'i dpe tshogs zhig lags pas/ rgya che'i mkhyen dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis dgyes gzigs gnang ste/ nang bsam blo'i shes yon gyi 'phel phyogs yang phyi dngos po'i 'phel rgyas dang do mnyam pa'i/ shes 'byor gnyis ldan gyi spyi tshogs bzang po zhig phyogs dang tha gru kun tu yong thub pa'i re smon yang yang zhu ba lags/'di yang mkhyen dpyod lhag bsam zla dang bral ba'i mkhas dbang gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' yis bskul ma gnang bar ji mi snyam du 'dor ma phod par cung zad tsam du smras pa'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes/ 2008lo'i zla 8 tshes 5 nyin phul/

bsdu sgrig gsal nga'ind/de yang rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa 'di ni zhang mkhas pa chen po nyi 'bum gyis ljags rtsom gnang ba zhig ste/ 'di'i ma dpe ni sngar 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin par grags shing / da lta dpe dngos ni khams dpal spungs dgon pa'i dpe mdzod nang du bzhugs yod/ spyi lo 2002lor gzan dkar rin po che'i bka' bzhin/dpal spungs dgon pa'i dpe rnying rnams srung skyobs dang 'brel dka/ra chag 'bri skabs nga tshor bu dpe zhig g.yar rgyu byung / 'on kyang ma dpe dngos la khams bris tshugs chung klog bde zhing mi gsal ba sogs med rung / nang don sa bcad dang / tshigs 'bru 'ga' shas chad 'dug pas kha bskong ma thub pa rnams la gug rtags stong pa zhig bzhag yod/ yang tha snyad 'ga' shas ni go shin tu dka' bas ming tshig dag po rang e yod na snyams pa byung yang / ma dpe sor bzhags kyis zhu dag byas cing / yi ge dag cha nor nges rnams ni deng dus yongs grags kyi brda sprod dang bstun nas bcos/ ma dpe dngos kyang da lam par skrun byed skabs lhan du bzhags nas rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char mkhyen ldan klog pa po rnams kyis 'di las dpe gzhan pa rnyed son byung na dag bcos gnang sdo— thugs bzhag yod pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di spyi tshogs thog 'grel spel byed skabs/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis mnyam las kyi sgo nas/ zhu dag dang / 'char 'god sogs rogs ram rgya chen gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang bcas/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/2008lo'i zla 6tshes10nyin la/

zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum/1158——1213khong ni yab rgyal ba zhang ston chen po dang yum rgyal mo g.yang nge gnyis kyi sras su/ rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag spyi lo1158la sku 'khrungs te/ lhums su zhugs dus yum gyi rmi lam du nyi ma mang po dus gcig la shar ba rmis pa la yab kyis rten 'brel brtags te/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i rtags yin gsungs nas mtshan la nyi ma 'bum zhes btags/dgung lo lnga tsam nas yi ge 'bri klog dang gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas par gyur/ lhag par du dgung lo lnga pa nas bcu'i bar lo lnga'i ring yab kyi mdun nas/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i thun mong thun min gyi gdams khrid mtha' dag bum pa gang byos kyis gsan/ dgung lo bcu par rgyud bcu bdun la bshad pa mdzad pas yab kyi bu slob kun ngo mtshar skye ba zhig byung / lo der yab zhing du gshegs te dgung lo nyi shu'i bar du sgrub pa nyams len kho na mdzad de bzhugs/de nas rngog rdo rje seng ge las gsar rgyud kyi gzhung dang man ngag mang po gsan bsam mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la jo mo rgya gar ma phyag rgyar bzhes/nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la sa skya'i 'khon grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / bla ma stag so ba bsten nas rgyud gsum gdams ngag daḍi —bcas pa dang / bde mchog mal rgya'i

rtsom pa po'i rnam thar/lugs sogs gsan/ sum cu par kha rag gi 'brug ston grags pa las bde mchog dang / rdo rje ma rā lugs/ ye shes mgon po sogs tshal pa'i chos skor rnams zhus/ zhad g.yu brag pa dang / gzhud gi rngog rdo rje seng ge sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang po bsten nas mdo rgyud du ma la thos bsam phyogs med du mdzad/ rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ slob ma gu ru jo 'bar gtso bor gyur pa'i skal ldan gyi slob ma mang po rjes su bzung ste/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa mtha' dag rdzogs par gnang ste/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug pa rab byung bzhi pa'i chu bya cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin nyi ma rtse shar tsam/ spyi lo1213la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas zhi bar gshegs so/ /brgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma/ gu ru jo 'bar sogs byon/gsung rtsom la/ rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas dzin bde legs kyis/—2—

dkar chagamachad brjad dang rtsam par dam bca' sags bshad pa/ blo spros pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi don du gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul gyis rgyud phyi ltar bshad pa/ ༷ ༷ 3blo spros med rnams kyi don du gzhung don man ngag nges pas nang ltar bshad pa/ ༷ 2shin tu spros med rnams kyi don du mtshan rang gzhung du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir mtshan gsang ba ltar bshad pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ 22blo rab tu spros med rnams kyi don du gsang ba bla na med pa yongs su rdzogs pa chen po ltar bshad pa/ 87bstan bcos yongs su rdzogs pa'i skabs/ 27—1—

༄tsho/ /rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa bsdokyigs sa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen dang / /bla ma dang ni yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro bde ba 'dzin pa la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mnyam pa la/ /gsol ba btab nas brjod pa'i brda/ /rdzogs chen gsang ba'i tshig gi bcud/ /bcu bdun rgyud la brten nas ni/ /rtogs par bya phyir rgyud kyi chings/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams ngag la/ /brten nas tshig gi 'phreng ba'i khrigs/ /me+ongs pa spangs pa'i blo yis 'bri/ /sangs rgyas rnams —sdosda gsungs pa'i bka'/ /

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/'grel dang yi ge mkhas su re bas slad/ /bka' dang mi 'gal lung gi them gsal ba'i/ /rgyud lung man ngag rnams las nges bkral ba/ /rgya mtsho'i gling las yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /yon tan 'byung khungs khams gsum rtog med gnad/ /tshig don gsal ba'i chos nyid mngon sum don/ /ma nor zhabrul pa med pa'i blo dang ni/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gdams ngag la/ /brten nas tshig don gsal bar dbye bar bya/ /de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po chos kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rigs lnga zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs nas/ sprul pa'i sku dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rgyas shing thugs rje che la thabs mkhas pa des/ gdul bya'i blo rig bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gzigs nas/ 'dul byed kyi chos kyi sgo dang theg pa'i 'dul stangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa las/ dbang po yang rab rnams kyi don du/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po las/ gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di skad ston pa las/ de la paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la mi tra'i bzhed pas/ bshad thabs kyi yan lag bzhis ston pa las/ blo spros pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi don du gleng gzhi —2—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul gyis rgyud phyi ltar bshad pa dang / blo spros pa med pa rnams kyi don du/ gzhung gi don man ngag nges pas nang ltar bshad pa dang / shin tu spros pa med pa rnams kyi don du/ mtshan rang gzhung du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ mtshan gsang ba ltar bshad pa dang / blo rab tu spros pa med pa rnams kyi don du/ don bsdus pa gsang ba bla na med pa yongs su rdzogs pa chen po ltar bshad pa'o/ /de nas dang po blo spros pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi don du/ gleng gzhi phun sum chogs pa'i don gyi rgyud phyi ltar bshad pa ni/ spyir rgyud thams cad gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa lnga yis ston par byed de/ de la gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa/ lnga 'dzoms pas chos 'byung ba yin te/ de yang thal 'gyur las/ rgyud 'byung gleng bzhi dngos po la/ lnga po rnams kyi sa bon 'dzin/ /ces pa dang bzhi ni rnam pa lnga yin te zhes gsungs/ nyi zla kha sbyor las/ gsang ba chen po'i rgyud rnams ni/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan pas/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar lngar nges pa'i 'thad pa'am dgongs pa ni/ gdul bya gang zag gi rgyud la 'dul zhing phung po lnga gnas pas/ 'dul byed dam gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa lnga ste/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag pa'i don du/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag pa'i don du/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/ 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa'i don du/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ ('dir tshor ba dang 'du byed —3—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/gnyis rnam par dag pa 'khor dang chos phun sum 'tshogs ma tshang bas chad pa yin nam/ 1 de yang thal 'gyur las/ gdul bya'i gang zag so so la/ /'dul bzhi phung po rnam pa lnga/ /zhes gsungs so/ /skabs 'dir bla ma rje btsun rin po ches phyi'i gnas la sogs pa gsungs te/ de ltar yang phun sum tshogs pa cha dgu las/ rnam par dbye na bzhi bcu rtsa lnga 'gyur te/ de'i cha dbye bar yang bka' las/ rgyud la 'jug pa yang mi 'gyur zhing / thun mong dang thun mong min par yang zhabrul pa'i phyir bla ma'i gsung yin par yang brjod do/ /brda sprod la reg shig bzhag la bshad do/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga po de'i gleng gzhi gnyis su 'gyur te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gleng gzhi gsang ba rang gzhung du bstan pa dang/ thun mong gi gleng gzhi gzhan dang sgo bstun gyi tshul du bstan pa dang gnyis las/ 'thad pa 'gal spong dang bcas ste bstan pa'o/ khri/da de nyid las lung gi gleng gzhi rnam pa gnyis/ /gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i rtags/ /zhes 'byung ba dang/ nyi zla kha sbyor las/ thun mong nyid dang thun mong min/ zhes gsungs so/ /de la thun mong ma yin pa'i gleng gzhi/ mtshon bya rtogs par bya ba'i don la/ gzhi dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs ji ltar gnas pa dang / de nyid kyi bkod pa lus la ji ltar gnas par bstan pa'o/ /dang po dngos po'i gshis kyi phun sum tshogs pa lnga ste/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba/ mtshan nyid gang yang ma grub pa/tshig dang yi ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa'o/ /dang po 'dug tshul gyi ston pa ni/spros gzhi tshig tsam du med pas/ sprordzu di ming du ma grub pa ni zhal phyag du

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/grub pa med pa'o/ /de lta bu'i ston pa la 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ chos nyid kyi rol pa rang byung rang shar ba'o/ /de lta bu'i 'bor la ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni don gyi brtan pa rang gi rig pa rang byung yang rang byung /rang shar yang rang shar du rgyu rkyen gang gis kyang ma skyed la skye 'jig dang bral ba/ kun la khyab cing / kun gyis mtshan nyid ma rtogs pa nyid do/ /de ltar dngos po gshis la gnas pa dang / ston pa dang / 'khor dang / bshad par bya ba'i chos dang bzhi 'dzoms pas ni/ dus phun sum tshogs pa/ thog ma dang tha ma med pas zhes bya'o/ /de skad du yang / rin po che spungs pa las med pa stong pa'i chos 'byung nas/ /ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /rig dang ye shes khyad par las/ /chos nyid stong pa'i rang sgra ni/ ye nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /thog ma bar mtha' med pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / yi ge med pa las/e ma nyon cig /snang ba dam pa'i 'khor rnams gnas lugs kyi rig pa la/snang thabs kyi rig pa la ma 'gag par gsal/ de skad ces rig pa'i gnas nas zhes pa dang / mu tig phreng ba las/ ston pa'i 'khor dang ston pa dang / /rang gi 'khor du 'dus pa dang / /zhes gsungs/ bkod pa lus kyi phun sum tshogs pa lnga ni/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa/rang gi lus kyi dkyil/ rtsa rnams 'dus pa'i 'khor lo/ tsit+ta rin po che'i gzhal yas khang / de nyid gnas yin pas yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su 'gyur la/ phun sum tshogs pa yin pas dal 'byor gtsang ma gcig gi lus la sku dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa yod pa la dgongs/ des gzugs sdug bsngal phra rab kyis —5—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhasapa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/bcingasapa las grol bar byed pa'o/ /de lta ra rang lus gnasasu shesapasagazhan gyi spros pa chod pas/ rdzogs pa chen po bya rtsol las 'das pa'i gnad kyis so/ /de lta bu'i gnas kyi nang du ston pa phun sum tshogasapa/ rang shes rig gi rgyal po/ gzhi kun tu bzang po kun khyab du bzhugasapa ni/ ston pa yin pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i char bzhugs pas/mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid du bzhugs pa zhes bya'o/ /phun sum tshogs yin pas/ shes rig ma 'gag par rang shar du shes shing sna tshogs kyi steng du grol bas na/ rnam shes yul dang shes pa bcings pa las grol ba'o// de lta bu'i ston pa rang la rang shar bas/ rdzogs pa po bya rtsol ba las 'das pa'i gnad do/ /de lta bu'i ston pa la 'khor gang zhe na/ sku lnga/ ye shes lnga/ 'od sna lnga/ shes rab lnga/ rlung la sogasapa lnga tshan gyis bskor ba 'og du ston te/ de yang 'khor yin pas de nyid la 'dus shing 'khor la phun sum tshogs pa yin pas/ rnam par dag pa'i rol pa sna tshogs su snang ba'o/ /de yang rang las byung bas na rang gi ye shes zhes bya'o/ /des 'du shes phyi nang gi bcings pa las grol bar bya'o/ /de lta bu'i 'khor la bshad par bya ba'i chos gang zhe na/ rtsa la brten pa'i mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi bde ba dang / rlung dang thig le la brten pa'i mi rtog pa'i bde ba'o/ /de yang rten yin pas 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas phun sum tshogs pa yin pas/ gang rung cig la brten nas nyams su blangs pas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /des tshor ba bde sdaspya —gi bcings pa las grol bar byed

rdzogasapa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/pa'o/ /de nyid rang las byung zhing rang shar bas rdzogs pa chen po gzhan rtsol dang bral ba'i gnad do/ /de ltar gnas/ lung ston pa/ rig pa/ 'khor sku dang ye shesastan pa rtsa rlung thabs kyis man ngag /da lta'i lus 'joms pas na/ dus yin da lta sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu ma thob na/ phyis bka' bas 'bad pa 'don/ phun sum tshogs pa yin pas dam pa'i chos dang / ston pa khyad par can gyi zhing khams dang / bdag las dang skal bar ldan pas tshogs bsags pas/ byang chub la thogs pa med pas 'du byed las dang nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pas bcings ba la sogs pa da lta nyid du bcad pas na'o/ /da lta gzhi rang sems ma bcos pa/ gnas lugs gcig gi ngo bor byung bas na/gnas la sogs pa gzhan nas btsal mi dgos pa rang byung gi ye shes zhes bya'o/ /de yang thal 'gyur las/ 'khor dang 'das pa'i thog mar ni/ /rang byung byas pa med pa las/ /'byung ba 'dus pa'i phung po shar/ /sa chu me rlung rin chen bzhi/ /dbus sa rlung sems rgyu dang rkyen/ /'du shes skyed pa'i gzhal yas na/ /rang byung rig pa bcos pa med/ /'khrul pa yongs su dag pa la/ /bde chen 'dus pa thabs kyi 'khor/ /sku dang ye shes shes rab rlung / /mi 'byed sna tshogs dmigs med pa/ /rtsa rlung thabs kyi bde chen chos/ /so so'i nyams dang mthun par bshad/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta med/ /snga phyi 'byed pa yongs su med/ /thams cad rang byung ye shes so/ / zhes gsungs so/ /des ni mtshon bya don gyi gleng gzhi bstan no/ /—7—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/da ni theg pa thun mong dang lung tsam zhig sgo bstun nas gleng gzhi ston to/ /mtshon bya dang mtshon par bya ba'i tshig sangs rgyas kyi bka' sgro bskur gyi dri ma dang bral ba la brten nas rtogs par byed do/ /de gsung pa po sku gsum gyi ston pa nyid kyis gsungs te/ chos sku'i byin gyis rlabs kyi sgo nas gsungs/ longs sku'i rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas gsungs/ sprul pa'i skus tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs pa'i sgo nas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu gsungs/gnas gang du gsung na/ chos sku'i gnas chos kyi dbyings/ longs sku'i gnas rnam dag stug po bkod pa/ sprul sku'i gnas lcang lo can rnam dag brtsegs pa la sogs par/ ston pa gang gis gsungs na/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/longs sku rnam par snang mdzad/ sprul pa'i sku dpal rdo rje sems dpa'/'khor gang la gsungs na/ chos kyi sku sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams brjod las 'das pa la/ longs sku'i 'khor sangs rgyas rigs lnga la sogs pa thabs kyi 'khor dpag tu med pa dang / nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa rigs lnga yab yum rnams dang / sa'i snying po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' dang / sgeg ma la sogs pa byang chub sems ma nyid las mi gzhan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/ sprul pa'i skusa'ajig rten las 'das pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos la sogs pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos la sogs pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol na 'jig rten pa'i 'khor lha —dz+warda po brgyad la sogs pa phyogs skyong

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/dang / gza' dang rgyu skar la sogs pa dang / lha dang klu dang lha ma yin dang /dri zar bcas pa 'jig rten pa'i gzugs su 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa la gsungs so/ /de dag mu tig phreng ba'i gleng gzhi las ston te/ de lta bu'i 'khor la chos phun sum tshogs pa gang gsungs na/ brjod du med pa'i chos sku'i gsung rang byung yi ge med pa/ sprul pa'i sku'i mdo rgyud bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dus nam gyi tshe gsung na/ chos sku rtogs pa rang snang longs sku chos nyid mngon par snang / sprul pa'i skus byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ 'khor ba ma stong kyi bar ram tshe lo dpag tu med pa nas brgya pa'i bar du gsungs so/ /de ltar gsungs pa gnas skabs su dus kyi phun sum tshogs pa zhes bya te/ thal 'gyur las/ gzhi ni rnam pa lnga yin te/ /gnas ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa sku gsum gyi phun sum tshogs pa sangs rgyas par bshad de/ rin po che sbungs pa las kyang gsungs te/ 'dzin pa rang dag chos sku yis/ /spros pa med pa'i gzhal yas su/ /nyid dang dbyer med snang 'khor la/ /mtshan ma med pa'i gsung gis ni/ /spros pa med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /mi gnas rang zad thugs las byung / /ma gsungs gsung pa med par ni/ /mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du brtan/ /rang gsal dag pa'i long sku yis/ /'od lnga rnam dag gzhal yas nas/ /spros med bde chen gsung gi ni/ /sku lnga rigs kyi 'khor rnams la/ /dngos med dag pa'i chos rnams ni/ /ye shes lnga 'dus thugs las byung / /rnam dag 'od zer ljags la bkram/ /rang byung yi ge drug du yang / /ma gsung rang byung chen por —9—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ shad mkhasapa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/bstan/ /rigs drug las dang skal ldan la/ /spros bcas tshig gi gsung gis ni/ /dbang po gang mos chos rnams yang / /dran pa rang gsal thugs la ni/ /dbang po 'dod med ljags la bkram/ /theg pa grangs med chos su bstan/ /de ltar sku gsung rang bshad pas/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyang tshims/ /de bzhin 'gro rnams re ba bskongs/ zhes gsungs so/ /des thun mong gi gleng gzhi bstan to/ /de ltar gleng gzhi gnyis su bstan pa'i 'thad pa ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gleng gzhi zhes bya ba ni/ 'di skad bdag gis bstan pa ste/ gzhan las ma gsungs pa'i ston pa'i phyir don rang gi mtshan nyid zab mo la dgongs pa'o/ /de yang thal 'gyur las/ gzhan las khyad par 'phags don du/ /thun mong min pa'i lus la sbyor/ /bcud rnams snying por bsdus pa ste/ /zhes bya ba dang / theg gzhan rnams dang sgo bstun phyir/ /thun mong dag gi gleng gzhi yis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i gleng gzhi gsungs pa ste/ dgongs ched gang gi phyir gsungs na/ 'di skad bdag gis bstan pa yin/ ston pa'i bka' nyid kyis/ 'khor gyi nang du gsungs pas/ rgyud pa nye zhing las khyad par du bstan pa'i phyir/ ston pas sdud pa po yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ ngas 'di ma yin pa'i zhing khams gzhan du 'khor gzhan la gsang ba'i rgyud 'di bstan pas/ 'gro gzhan sangs rgyas so/ /zhes khyod yid ches par gyis la nyon zhes pa'i tshig go /yang rgyud de nyid las/ ston pa'i gsung gis 'khor la bstan/ /ngo mtshar mchog 'dus bstan pa'i gtso/ /zhes gsungs so/ /—10—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/de skad thos pa ni sdud pa po'i gsung yin te/ sdud pa po kho rang gi 'khor yid ma ches dgongs nas/ ston pa dang bar na brgyud pa gzhan med par/ bdag rang gis 'di skad thos zhes sgro 'dogs spyad pas kho rang gi 'khor la yid ches skyed pa'i phyir bstan pa yin no/ /de skad du yang thun mong dag gi gleng gzhi yis/ sdud pa po 'khor rnams la/ yid ches par bya ba'i phyir bstan to/ /'dul gzhi las ni 'dul byed du/ /'byung ba bstan pa gnas par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /de la 'gal ba spongs pa ni/ de ltar gnyis su bstan pas 'gal lo zer na/ bstan pa thos pa gnyis 'gal zer ram/grangs gnyis 'gal zer/ bstan pa 'di 'gal zer na/ gsang ba snying po las/ 'di skad bdag gis bshad pa'i dus gcig na/ /zhes gsungs pa de 'gal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis bshad pa yod kyang thos pa med zer na/med pa de yang dag pa yin nam ma yin/ yin na thos pa yod pa rnams ma dag par 'gal la/ ma yin na de nyid dngos 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang 'di thos pas 'dod pa yin zer na/ rgyud kyis ston pa'i phyir 'dir yang dgongs can yin bya'o/ /yang thos pa yod pa rnams yang dag pa yin na/ med pa rnams ma dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'di yang dag par grub ste/ ston pa bstan pa pos thos pa 'di la 'gal ba med pa la/ gal te 'gal zer na smyon tshig smra bar gsal lo/ /spyir snar mar smra na mdo rgyud la lar bstan pa dang bshad pa gsungs pa la/ la lar ni thos gsungs/ la lar ni gnyisaka gsungs/ la lar ni gnyis ka ma gsungs / 'gal ba med par shes par bya'o/ /grangs —11—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/gnyis la 'gal zer na/ pha rol tu phyin pa las/ 'khor 'das gnyis bden pa gnyis dang / gsang sngags thun mong du mtshan gzhung gnyis dang /gsang sngags las bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang / thabs shes bstan pa las 'gal ste/ gnyis su byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des blo spros pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi don du gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul gyis rgyud phyi ltar bshad pa bstan ta/ /da ni blo spros pa med pa rnams kyi don du/ gzhung don man ngag nges pa ltar bshad pa ni/ yid ma ches par ches par bya ba'i phyir lo rgyus kyi don dang / theg pa spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la 'jug ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir/yo ga phyogs kyi don bstan pa dang / rtsal ba can chad pa nang dang bar bya ba'i phyir/ dgos ched kyi don bstan pa dang / tshig 'bru choms par bya ba'i phyir/skabs 'jed tshig gis don bstan pa dang / rang rang gi spri gzhi dang bral ba'i ngang du/ chos thams cad 'dus par bstan pa'i phyir na rtsa ba mtshan gyi don bstan pa'o/ /de skad du nyi zla kha sbyor las/ rtsa ba'i don gyi mtshan ngos bzung / /yo ga'i don gyisa'ajug sgo bstan/ /dgos ched don gyis rang sar bzhag /tshig gi don gyis skyus gnyis sprad/ /lo rgyus don gyisayid rnams tshims/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar lngar nges pa'i 'thad pa ni/ gdul bya gang zag cig gi rgyud la/ 'dul gzhi nyon mongs pa lnga yod pas/ de'i 'dul byed gnyen por gsungs te/ de dag kyang gti mug can 'jug cing dmigs med gtad med pa'i sgom pa la dgongs pa dang / zhe sdang can 'jug —12—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/cing gza' gtad med pa'i lta ba la dgongs pa dang / 'dod chags can 'jug cing blang dor med pa'i spyod pa la dgongs pa dang / nga rgyal can 'jug cing gol 'grib med pa'i gzhi la dgongs pa dang / phrag dog can 'jug cing spangs thob med pa'i 'bras bu la dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar lnga las lhag na don med la/ nyungs na mi tshang bas lnga kho nar nges te/ de nyid la lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i don gyis ma bshad na/ /chos rnams rig par mi 'dus pas/ /mtha' yas pa yi skyon du 'gyur/ /yo ga don gyis ma bshad na/ /theg pa'i ru shan mi phyed pas/ /che chung rim pa don med 'gyur/ /tshig gis don gyis ma bshad na/ /rgyud rnams rim par gsal ba'i tshig /'bru mi choms pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /dgos ched don gyis ma bshad na/ /rdzogs chen 'bad rtsol med pa la/ /don med pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dang po yid ches pa'i lo rgyus kyi don gnyis ste/ rten gyi gang zag cig thob par byed pa la sangs rgyas kyi lo rgyus dang / sems can gyi lo rgyus gtam rgyud rin po ches gtan la phab pa'o/ /dang po rten gang zag cig sangs rgyas par bya ba'i lo rgyus ni/ gang zag log rtog can dag de ltar phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan kyang / sangs rgya bar byed pa'i thabs nyams su len pa'i mngon rtogs lag len med zer na/ de la rgyud kyi gzhung tshig don bcu gcig gi 'chi ste/thog mar rtogs te sangs rgyas ma byung / ma rtogs te sems can ma byung ba'i sngon rol na/ gzhi dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs ji ltar gnas pa bstan —13—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang lal/ zhang mkhasapa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/dang / de lta bur gnas pa de las 'khruldopa ji ltar byung tshul gtan la dbab pa dang / 'khrul na sems can la yang dag par rdzogasapa'i sangasargyas kyi zhing khams sa bon ji ltar gnas bstan pa dang / de nyid gnas pa rang gang na gnas pa dang / de ltar gnas pa'i ye shesade lam gang nas byung dang / de ltar lam nas 'byung ba'i rig pa'i ye shes sgo gang na 'char ba dang / sgo nas shar ba'i rig pa'i ye shes de yul gang la snang ba dang / yul la snang ba'i rig pa'i ye shes de rten gyi gang zag gis ji ltar nyams su blangs pa dang /nyams su lon pa'i rtags dang tshad gang gis bzung ba dang / 'di nyid de lta bu'i man ngag yod kyang le lo g.yengs nas nyams su len longs ma byung na/chos nyid kyi bar do la ji ltar 'char ba dang / mthar thug grol ba chen po gang yin pa bstan pa'o/ /de skad du yang thal 'gyur las/ 'khor ba'i thog ma gnad 'di gang / /sems ni 'brul pa ci las byung / /rang rig ye shes gnas lugs gang / /gnas pa gang na gnas pa lags/ /de nyid lam yang gang nas byung / /ye shes 'char ba'i sgo ni ci/ /yul gyi gnad ni gang la 'char/ /nyams su ji ltar len pa lags/ /de'i rtags dang tshad snang ci/ /bar ma do yi snang ba ci/ /rang semasagrol ba gang du grol/ /zhes gsungs/mu tig 'phreng ba las kyang / gnas lugs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang ye shes rnam pa lnga bshad kyang / /lhun grub dang ni thugs rje'o/ /rang gnas sku rig ye shes so/ /gnas pa thugasani tsit+ta'i dkyil/ /lam ni rtsabazhi 'gyu byed rlung / /'char byed sgo ni mig sogs bzhi/ /yul ni sprin bral mkha' —14—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcigapa/la'o/ /nyams blangs khregs chod thod rgal lo/ /tshad ni gdeng bzhi rnal 'byor nyid/ /bar do ma bu gnyis sbyor ba/ grol ba nyid ni thog ma'o/ /zhesagasungs/ de la dang po rtogs ste sangs rgyas ma byung / ma rtogs ste sems can ma byung pa'i sngon rol na/ gzhi dngos po gshis kyi 'dug tshul ji ltar gnas pa ni/ spyir rdzogs pa chen po'i lugs kyi 'dod lugs bdun las mi gda' ste/ gzhi lhun grub 'dod pa'i lugs dang / ma nges par 'dod pa'i lugs dang / nges pa don gyi dngos gzhir 'dod pa'i lugs dang / cir yang sgyur du btub par 'dod pa'i lugs dang / cir yang khas blangs du btub par 'dod pa'i lugs dang / gzhi sna tshogs su 'dod pa'i lugs dang /gzhi ka dag du 'dod pa'i lugs dang / bdun 'das so/ /de skad du yang thal 'gyur las/ babs las grub pa'i gnas lugs ni/ /gnas pa bdun gyi tshul la yang / /sna tshogs nges nas lhun grub la/ /'gyu tshad cha las nges med la/ /mi 'gyur ba la nges pa can/ /snang ba'i tshad ni cir yang 'gyur/ /thams cad 'byung phyir khas blangs bcas/ /'khrul pa dag phyir ka dag dang / /snang tshul tha dad khra bor 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /klong drug pa las kyang / thog ma babs kyi grub pa'i gzhi/ /yod pa gcig las med pa las/ /'khrul par snang ba'i phyogs dag nas/ /rtog tshogs rnams kyi gtan phab nas/ /rim pa bdun gyi tshul du snang / /ngo bo gcig gi snang tshul las/ /gcig ma shes pas de ltar snang / /'on kyang de don 'di ltar ste/ /lhun grub nyid du gnas par snang / /sna tshogs sdud pa'i snying por snang / /nges —15—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ shad mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/pa med par gnas pa la/ /'gyu byed yid byas rnam par snang / /nges par rang ngor gnas pa la/ /dran byed 'pho ba med par snang / /sgyur du btub par gnas pa las/ /'bad de blo yi rnam par snang / /ci'i ngo bo gnas pa la/ /gang snang rang gi ngo bor snang / khra bo dag du gnas pa la/ /sna tshogs so so'i tshul du snang / /ka nas dag par gnas pa la/ /dri ma ye nas med par snang / /'di kun blo'i rim pa las/ /rang ngo ka nas dag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar shes bya'i gzhi bdun la 'dod lugs gnyis su dbye ste/ gzhi drug skyon can du gnas pa dang / ka dag skyon med rang gzhung du gtan la dbab pa'o/ /de nyid shes par byed pa'i gang zag gi blo'i rigs kyang gnyis te/ grub mtha' rjes su 'dzin pa'i gang zag dang / lam rjes su 'dzin pa'i gang zag /de la grub mtha' rjes su 'dzin pa'i gang zag gis/gzhi bdun la 'dod pa grub pa dang / sun 'byin pa dang / rgol ba dang /las dang / bzhi skor du gtan la phab pas/ shes bya thams cad gtan la phebs par 'dod do/ /de grub mtha'i skor gzhan dang / klong drug la sogs pa las shes par bya'o/ /gang zag de ni rdo rje gdan ma mthong bar/ rdo rje gdan gyi lo rgyus bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /'dir gtso bor lam rjes su 'dzin pa'i gang zag gis/ shes bya'i blo'i spros pa rnam par bcad nas gzhi gnas lugs rang gi ngo bo rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ 'di kun blo'i rim pa las/rang ngo ka nas dag pa'o/ /gsungs pas/ gzhi drug po ngo bo ka dag gi rtsal du shes par bya ste/ grub mtha' skyon med nyams su len pa ni/ rdo rje gdan —16—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/mthong nas bshad pa dang 'dra'o gsungs/ de ltar yin gyis kyang 'dir bshad pa'i sgros ma nyams par bya ba'i phyir/ grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i gang zag gis/ gzhi drug skyon du 'dod pa la sogs pa zur tsam bstan par bya ste/dngos po gzhi lhun grub tu 'dod pa la/ shes bya bzhi bskor du gtan la dbab na/ lhun grub kyis gnas lugs rgya/ gar yang ma chad phyogs gang yang ma lhung ba'o/ /des sun dbyung ba/ lhun grub tu 'dod pa 'di skyon can/lhun gyis grub pa'i dus na 'bras bu yang grub pas/ dper na 'o ma la mar lhun gyis grub pa dang 'dra'o/ /zhe na/ de bzhin du 'bras bur rgyu grub bam ma grub/ grub na 'bras bu rgyur song pas 'bras bu la gtad med pas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas la rgyu sems can 'khor bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir na gang zag gis 'bad pa la don med do/ /ma grub na lhun grub kyi 'dod pa nyams so/ /yang rgyu'i dus na ni grub la/ 'bras bu'i dus ma grub bo zhe na/ lhun grub res 'jog dang bcas par song bas/ yod med mthar lhung gi lta bar 'gyur ro/ /lhun gyis grub pa gang yang min no zhe na/ sems tsam pa gzhan dobang don dam du 'dod pa rnams dang khyad mi rnyed/ de'i phyir rgyu dang 'bras bu khas mi len na mngon sum snyon pas lung rigs kyi don de/ klong drug pa las/ rgyu dang 'bras bu tha dad pas/ /yang na lhun grub ma lags so/ /de bzhin/ rgyu dang 'bras bu gcig na/ /'bad pa rnams la dgos med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgol lan gnyis ni shugs las 'byung ngo / /de ni de ltar mi 'dod do/ ngo bo ka nas dag pas 'khor ba ma grub par rang bzhin sna tshogs —17—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhad mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/su shar bas 'das pa ma grub/ ngo bo rang bzhin gnyis su med pas ye nas 'khrul ma myong ba'i bdag nyid du bzhugs so/ /gzhi ma nges par 'dod pa ni/nges med ming ni sna tshogs las/ /don gyis rtag pa tsam gyis stong / /rang bzhin cig tu ma nges pas/ /gang ltar rtag pa de ltar snang / /zhesaso/ /ma ngesapa ni de la ming gis ma nges sam/ don gyisam nges/ ming gis ma nges na/ chos la dgos pa med la/ ci'i chos thams cad ming yin pa'i phyir/ don gyis ma nges na/ don chos nyid las ming 'khor bas na/ don me las chu skye bar gyur ste mngon sum du dgag du mi btub bo/ /ming yin pa'i phyir me las chu skyes par 'gal lo zhe na/ me las chu skye ba cis shes ming yin pas shes so/ /ming don ma yin pa'i nges med cig du 'dod na ni/ phung po gsum pa 'gyur ro/ khyud las/ 'bras bu re 'jog can nyid dam/ yang na rtog bcas nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bye ma las kyang / ming sogs ngesapa med yin na/ /'byung ba'i byed pa so sor 'gyur/ /zhes sogs/ 'di ni ming don gang du 'ang mi byed pas/ ye nas ma skyes pa'i chos nyid la da skye mi srid pa zhes bya'o/ /gzhi nges pa'i don gyi dngos gzhi 'dod pa ni ngo bo 'gyur ba med par nges pa ni mkha' lta bu/ snang tshul du sgyur du btub par nges pa med pa chu zla lta bu/ nges par 'dod pa de rtogs nas nges par 'dod dam ma rtogs kyang 'dod/ rtogs nas 'dod na gzhi mi btub ste/ gzhi la rtog pa bskyed bya skyed byed gnyis su 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'og ma ltar na 'khor 'das te chad na skyon spangs par mi nus so/ /gal te rtogs pa med par nges —18—

rdzogs pa r+sā po tshig don r+sā snyag pa/ṭā yin zhe na/tsowa 'das sus kyang nidagarnyi par mi khegs par mngon sum gyas gsaṭ+wāṃ la//'a ltar 'dad pa phyi mu gas rtag parami lta ba rnams dang khyad par rnyed do/khyud las/de ra de yang yang dag na/yang na rgyur 11/dro //rngo/ ///she ///khabyes 'bras bu des pas/baṭ+wāṃg rtaṭ+wāṃ pa dang khyad sad swār/ pa ṅgi /malas/rgyudi'abras bu snang ra/gralo ba nyad du 'gyuṭ+wāṃ ra//me gsungs sa//'a rtakris nga byā rang dang ma rtagasame rang gapy-i gnyos su zhibye pas/ka nas dag pa' chasonyadaldus wī+oro ba dpari bya'//ga yang sgyur sdo gas par 'dadapan/nga ba phyagasadangasdosurnyichadapas/snang tshul car ༵ sgyur du gas pa'o//sgyur du bakha pa rtakri nga sgyur du gas pa'am/ rtag kyang zlokhung/rta/ no sgyur du bsdu pa' dam kau' nyamasal/'gadī ltar nagertag pa yaṭ+wāṃ pa'am/ dpa/yaṭ+wāṃ na sa nas ṭ+wāṃd dam mamesanasayad/rangalas sbya sam ṭ+wāṃtīsmrasas/rong las sa na thug mid ṭaṃ wī+or la/rang ladī ga du sa ṭ+wāṃ sa par 'dad papyengakaudapar sadad//gtīlasamis ṭ+wāṃrgyu gagagam tha dadu/gag yaspya bye gtī gya dmo bca'adzño mas/ gag na rgyu 'bras 'akril ta chulas bor swār ra//ma sa par yad na sgyur ñdzi bakha pa' dam bca' nyarnyis sa//daṭ+wāṃnanom mkha' la kha ṭ+wāṃg gtī gyas sgyur sdo bzhi porathal /gas na no k+ta//rtasna pa dang spya pa gang yang ṭā yano pa' ngos nas sgyur du gnyi ba na/ sa bya yad da las rgyaṭ+wāṃ kyas ṭ+wāṃgs sa/khyud las/rang gnas lugs 9sgyur du gas na//'a las sa pa

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/med par mtshungs/ /'bras bu nyid ni rgyur zlog phyir/ /'bad pa rnams la dgos med pas/ /yang dang yang du rtogs pas na/ /bem po rnams ni rig bcas su/ /'gro bar btub pa ma yin bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni rtag pa ma yin pas stong pa ngos bzung med/ mi rtag pa ma yin pas shes rig rang ngo na gsal ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhi ci yang khas blang du btub par 'dod pa ni dngos po kun gyi dngos gzhi ste/ dngos po kun gyi rang shar phyir/ ci yang khas len pa'o/ /de ltar len pa de yod nas khas len nam med nas len/yod na rtag par yod dam mi rtag kyang yod/ rtag par yod na khas len pa'i dam bca' nyams/ mi rtag par yod na yod ces pa'i tshig gis gsal/ med kyang khas len na mo shaṃ bu skye ba la sogs pa gnad do/ /yod ma yin par 'dod na'ang shes bya las rgyab kyis phyogs so/ khuspyod las/ thams cad dngos por grub pa'i phyir/ /thug pa med pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni dngos po yod par ma grub pas/ rgyu mtshan gang gis kyang gtan la mi phebs/ med pa cham ma chad pas/ gsal shes rang rig pa'i ngo bo la shar ba'o/ gzhi sna tshogs 'dod pa ni ngo bo kun tu rang shar ba'i phyir/ snang tshul khra bo sna tshogs su rang shar ba'o/ /sna tshogs su 'dod pa de snang ba las 'dod dam shes pa las 'dod/ snang ba las 'dod na snang tshul mi 'dra bzhin du gzhan yang sna tshogs su snang ba ni sems tha dad pa dang che chung du sgyur yang mi nus pas/ mu stegs rig pa can na re/ 'gro ba mi lus mi 'dra ba'i phyir sems kyang che chung dang dbyibs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa snang ba'i phyir zer ba —20—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/dang khyad par mi rnyed do/ tags pa la 'dod na/ shes pa skad cig ma la mi 'dra ba brgya 'gyur ba bzhin du/ gzhi yang 'gyur bas 'bad pa byas pa la dgos pa med pa'am yang na 'bad mi dgos par grol bar 'gyur ro/ khuyid las/ rgyu gcig 'bras bu tha dad pas/ /gang gi ngo bo de snang la/ /'bras bu tha dad don des mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni ngo bo gang du yang ma grub pas mtshan gzhi dang bral ba/ rang bzhin nam snang ba rang thog nas grol bas/ spang blang dgag sgrub med pa'o/ /de ltar drug gis skyon can ngos bzung ba bstan pa'o/ /gnas lugs drug po de ngo bo nyid kyi skyon can ma yin te rtsal phyogs re la brtag na nor ba'ang ma yin la de la ngo bo nyid bden par bzung na/ shin tu zhabrul ste/ dper na long ba rnams kyis glang po che la bltas pa lta bu'am/ skyes pa'am bud med gang yang rung ba cig la nye 'brel du mas so sor zhen pa lta bu'am/ la kha'i skyes pa drung cig la mthong ltas rigs dgur mthong ba dang 'dra'o/ /de ni skyon med rang gzhung ston par byed de/ 'di la gnyis ste/ ka dag skyon med de la rtsod pa spangs pa dang / ka dag gi gnas lugs dngos bstan pa'o/ /dang po skyon med du sgrub pa ni/ chos nyid ka dag spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ ma rig pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pas/ sgrib phyogs thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir/ klong drug pa las/ spros bral chos nyid ka dag ni/ /rang ngo rnam dag snying po'i gzhi/ /de la tshig dang yi ge bral/ /brjod pas gtan la dbab tu med/ /sgro 'dod tha snyad kun dang bral/ /bzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog med/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems —21—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhasapa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/can med/ /chos med chos kyi 'du shes med/ /gang med ci med ci yang med/ /de ltar med pa'i snying po la/ /re zhig tshig gis gtan phab nas/ /ngo bo nyid la ka dag la/ /rang bzhin du ni lhun grub bo/ /de la rtsol ba'i skyon spangs pa/ /ngo bo nyid ni ka dag pas/ /sems can 'khor ba 'di mi rigs/ /ma rig dri ma ye zad phyir/ /ston pas gsungs pa sems dpa' che/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ /de yang ma 'gags rol par snang / /sems pa nyid kyis yang gsol pa/ /rang bzhin nyid la lhun grub na/ /sems can 'di dag rang grol rigs/ /ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir/ /gsungs pas/sems can 'di dag gi ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i phyir/ grol ba rnams kyang rol par snango / zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag ni/ grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i dbang du byas pa'/ /da ni skyon med rang gi mtshan nyid ka dag gi gnas lugs dngos rgyas pa ston pa ni/ thog ma'i gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs ka dag ye shes gsum gyi bdag nyid can du gnas te/ thal 'gyur las/ 'khor dang 'das pa mi dmigs pa'i/ /chos nyid stong pa kun khyab pas/ /ye shes rang sar gnas pa la/ /gsum gyis tshul du dbyer med kyang / /zhes gsungs pa dang / rang shar las kyang / ka dag chen po'i gzhi la yang / /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mu tig phreng ba las kyang gnas lugs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /ye shes rnams pa gsum yin no/ /zhes pa dang / kun tu bzang po klong drug pa las kyang / /ye shes nyid ni rnam gsum gyis/ /bzhi —22—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/pa'i khyad par tshig tu bstan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar ye shes gsum gyi mtshan nyid la gnas lugs ji ltar bzhugs na/ slob dpon bye ma las gsungs pa/ ye shes gsum gyi bdag nyid de/ /ngo bo ka dag ye shes ni/ /ma rig la sogs rtog pa dag /rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes ni/ /gsal byed rang dwangs nyid du gnas/ /thugs rje kun khyab ye shes ni/ /'gag med rol pa ci yang snang / /zhes gsungs pa'i don rgyas par thal 'gyur gsungs pas/ngo bo ka dag ye shes la/ /ma rig pa zhes srid mi med/ /gcig dang gnyis kyi grangs med pas/ /gang du ma che chos nyid la/ /ye shes tsam du grub pa med/ /rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes zhes/ /rtsal dang yon tan 'gag med pas/ /rol pa tsam du snang pa las/ /sna tshogs rdzogs pa'i gzhi ma'o/ /thugs rje kun khyab ye shes las/ /mi mdzad sna tshogs 'char ba'i sgo/ /mdzad pa ltar snang ngo bo rdzogs/ /chos sku stong pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ye shes mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i cha/ khugs kyi sems can rnams la 'char/ /'di med 'khor 'das sde chad pas/ /mkhyen pas rig cing gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar ngo bo la ma rig pa yod ma myong pas/ rig pa tsam du grub yang med/ rig ma rig gi tha snyad las 'das pas/ 'khrul ma 'khrul zhes bya ba tsam grub pa med do/ /mu tig 'phreng ba las/ thog ma nyid kyi ka dag la/ /'khrul zhes tsam du brjod du med/ /de bzhin ma zhabrul ba yang ci/ /de phyir 'brul pa gdod nas dag /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar ka nas dag pa zhes bya/ dang po nas dag pas thog ma dag la gdod ma nas dag pa —23—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/zhes bya/ ka zhes thog mar byung pa la/ dag pas dri ma'i drangs mtha' zad ces gsungs so/ /de ltar ngo bo ye dag rang bzhin rang dag thugs rje shugs dag du gnas pa zhes bya'o/ /ngo bo stong par gnas pas tha snyad kyis brtag pa gang du'ang med / rang bzhin gsal bar bzhugs pas rgyu rkyen gang la yang rag ma lus/ thugs rjes khyab par bzhugs pas du ma dang cha shas dang bral ba'o/ /de ltar yang / ngo bo ka dag brjod gzhi bral/ /rang bzhin lhun grub ci snang rdzogs/ /thugs rje kun khyab rang shar ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying gi me long las kyang / gzhi'i chos thams cad ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum du shes par gyis shig /ngo bo'i chos thams cad stong par shes par gyis shig /rang bzhin gyi chos thams cad gsal bar shes par gyis shig /thugs rje'i chos thams cad kun la khyab par shes par gyis shig /zhes gsungs so/ /ngo bo stong pa'i cha nas rtag mthar 'dzin pa'i phyogs su ma lhung / rang bzhin lhun grub/ thugs rje kun la khyab pa'i cha nas rtag cha gnyis ka dang ma yin pa'i phyogs su ma lhung / rang grol las/ mtha' bzhi'i dri ma rang sangs nyid/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de dag mdor bsdus nas gsungs na/ ngo bo snang stong dbyer med/ rang bzhin gsal stong dbyer med/thugs rje rigs stong dbyer med du bzhugs so/ /de ltar bzhugs na/ ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i ye shes nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bur bzhugs so/ /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho dwangs pa lta bur bzhugs so/ /thugs rje kun khyab kyi ye shes nor bu dri ma med pa ltar bzhugs so/ /—24—

rdzogasapa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/de ltar bzhugs pa'i ye shes rang gi mtshan nyid de ngo bo sku ru bzhugs so/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal du bzhugs so//thugs rje rig pa ye shes su bzhugs te/ de la ngo bo skur gnas kyang sku gsum 'char gzhi tsam las zhal phyag tu grub pa ni med do/ /'di la kha cig gis shes rab dang 'od kyi kha mig rna ba can la sogs pa byas nas 'dug ste/ ma hā yo ga gol sa spangs par mi nus so/ /gal te kha mig rna ba can yod na ni dbang po gzugs can yod dam/yid tsam du yod/ gzugs can du yod na ni 'gro drug phal pa dang khyad med/yid tsam du yod na ni skye mched mu bzhi dang yid dgas dang khyad par mi rnyed do/ /rang shar las/ chos sku rnam dag chen po la/ /dngos po bzung du med pa'i phyir/ /mtshan ma can du rtag pa med/ /gal te mtshan ma yod na'ang / /chos sku bzung du yod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang bzhin gyi ngos nas 'od gsal du gnas ste kha dog ris can du grub pa med de/ 'di la kha cig gis 'od lnga'i mtshan nyid dang kha dog bshad pa 'dug ste/ 'di rab tu mi 'thad/ chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis khyad par med par skyon spangs par mi nus so/ /de nyid las/ mtshan ma can du rtog pas na/ /chos sku gzugs skur yod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos thams cad kyi nang nas stong pa nyid do zhes bya bar bshad pa rnams dang yang 'gal lo/ /thugs rje'i cha nas 'char gzhi 'gag med du gnas pas kun la khyab pa'i ye shes sokhri/'di la la nas ye shes rgyun chad yin zhes bya bar byas 'dug ste/ ye shes kyi 'char gzhi med na ni/ sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i cha med pas/ yang na chang —25—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/chad pa'i bem po la sogs pa'i cha ni spang bar mi nus so/ /de ltar phar phyin las/ ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med/ /rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med pa 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la bye brag du bla na med pa 'di nyid kyi bzhed pas/ phyin ci ma log pa'i gnas lugs 'di ngo bo mi 'gyur bar skur bzhugs pas sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i 'char gzhir bzhugs kyang mtshan ma ris can gyi zhal phyag du grub pa ni med/ rang bzhin gsal ba'i 'od gsal du bzhugs pas gdangs gsum rang gsal kyang kha dog ris can du grub pa ni med do/ /thugs rje rig pa'i ye shes su bzhugs pas mkhyen pa'i cha ma 'gag pas so sor gsal kyang bya ba byed pa med do/ de ltar mkhyen pa'i cha gzhi gnas kyi ye shes gsum du bzhugs so/ /de'i gsal bya ni/ thal 'gyur las/ thog ma'i ngo bo rang bzhin dang / /thugs rje rnam pa gsum du gnas/ /de yang ngo bo skur gsal bas/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa'i char/ /ma phye 'byed pa med pa'i tshul/ /babs las grub pa nyid las yang / /sku mdog la sogs blo yul med/ /rang bzhin 'char byed 'od kyi tshul/ /dkar dmar ser dang ljang mthing ni/ /mtshan ma ris can ma yin par/ /ris med shes bya'i babs las grub/ /thugs rje 'char ba sna tshogs las/ /'di 'dra gcig du ma nges pas/ /sna tshogs snang phyir gzhi zhes bya/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis mdor bstan nas gsungs/ rig pa rang shar las kyang / gzhi ka dag chen po zhes bya ste/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum du gnas so/ /ngo bo mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes ma 'gag par gsal ba —26—

rdzogs pa chen po dzig don bcu gcig pa/gzhon nu bum pa sku'i gnas lugs zhes bya'o/ /rang bzhin ni 'od lnga'i snang ba ma 'gag pa'o/ /thugs rje'i snang ba ni dper na sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /de ni ka dag gi gnas lugs zhes bya ste/ rgya gar yang ma chad phyogs gar yang ma lhung pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid klong drug pa las rgyas par gsungs te/ ngo bo ka dag ye shes kyis/ /ma rig pa yi dri ma bral/ /rang bzhin lhun grub ye shes kyis/ /zhabrul pa'i tshig gi snod pa bral/ /thugs rje kun khyab ye shes kyis/ /thams cad dbyings cig 'brel bar snang / /de yang re shig tshig mtshan tsam/ /de ltar chos nyid ka dag las/ /ye shes med cing sku yang med/ /'od med kha dog rnams dang bral/ /gang gi ngo bo grub med pas/ /ma rig pa dang nyon mongs kyis/ /smos ci dgos te yod pa min/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi snang ba las/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa med pas so/ /(kha ma yin rang gsal bas/ 1tags shing rig pa'i cha rnams tshangs/ /'dzin pa'i gzung yul gang med phyir/ /rnams par rtog pa'i 'dzin cha med/ /'do las 'das pa'i ye shes su/ /rnam dag phyag rgya chen por gnas/ /'on te rang bzhin snang ba la/ /mtshan mar 'dzin pa ye med de/ /don gyi cha la 'di ltar gnas/ /rang dngas skyed pa dkar po'i cha/ /stong gsal chen po nyid du gnas/ /stong gsal ngo bo skrag skyed pa/ /snang ba rang zad so so'i cha/ /mi mngon dbyings nas rang gsal lo/ /rang ngo chags pa med skyes pas/ /rang gis bcings pa bral ba yi/ /chags pa rang zad dmar po'i char/ /steng dang ma 'dres chen por gnas/ /ma 'dres so so'i mtshan 'dzin pa/ /bya —27—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhad mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/rtsal spyod pa rang bral ba'i/ /mdzad pa med pa'i ljang khu ni/ /thog ma rnams kyi zer du yang / /mi mngon steng nas gsal ba'i cha/ /steng gsal khyab pa'i brel byed pa/ /'gyur med rdzogs pa'i mthing dkar ni/ /ye rdzogs byas pa med par gnas/ /de ltar 'di yi rang bzhin la/ /sku ni snang la mtshan nyid bral/ /ye nas rang dag chen po la/ /rdzogs pa rnams kyi rtse mor gnas/ /'di la dbang por snang ba med/ /gdos bcas mtshan ma rang dag phyir/ /steng gsal chen po'i gzhi mar gnas/ khyab dang khyab pa nyid kyis stong / /chad nas chad pa med snang bar/ /gsal byed snang ba'i cha la 'gags/ /snying po thams cad bcud bsdus pa'i/ /dri ma med cing rang sar dag /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang chen dang / /rang bzhin gyi ni cha la bzhugs/ /thugs rje'i snang cha sna tshogs pas/ /stong pa 'gags pa med pa las/ khrigs bya'i ye shes rnam gnyis su/ /snang ba'i cha la snang bar gsal/ /med pa'i snang ba rang dag pas/ /rang bzhin shugs kyi thugs rje nyid/ /mdzad pa'i rtsol ba ye med par/ /ma byas snang ba'i tshul dag tu/ /ye nas 'byed pa med par snang / /nyi ma las ni 'od bzhin du/ /rang gis byas pa ma yin te/ /rang gis rang gzhan de ltar snang / tags bya'i ye shes gnyis med na/ /bems po rnams dang khyad ci yod/ /yang na stong pa chang chad du/ /'di nyid 'gyur ba kho na'o/ /shes bya ji ltar mkhyen pa yi/ /thugs rje'i cha yi ye shes kyi/ /rang gi dngos po gnas lugs mkhyen/ /ye shes de'i cha med na/ 'byung bzhi'i gzugs dang khyad ci yod/ shes bya ji snyed mkhyen pa yi/ /(1yi ni ye shes kyi/ gdul bya —28—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/rnams kyi bsam pa mkhyen/ /'di med nam mkha' nyid dang mtshungs/ /de phyir thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /ye shes thugs rje cha la snang / /'di kun dran pa bzung ba med/ /rang bzhin nyid du gnas pa las/ /gzung 'dzin rags par mi gnas so/ /stong gsal phra ba'i char snang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid da lta gang zag gi rgyud la sbyar na/ rig pa ngo bo 'khrul ma myong pas/rang bzhin ma 'khrul pa yi gnas/ /de nyid ma 'khrul pa mi gnas pas/ /thugs rje 'khrul mi srid pa'o/ /de ltar gang zag gi rang rig pa zhabrul ma myong bar go bas/ da lta lus ngag gi bya ba ci byas kyang / da lta 'khrul pa la mi gnas par go /de ltar bas phyis 'khrul mi srid par thag chod pa ni/ khams gsum du mi ldog pa'i gnad do/ /gal te dag tu med na gzhi btub pa ma yin no/ /de ltar yang thal 'gyur las/ rab tu lam la rdzogs pa yis tha ma 'gro ba'i lus la khyab/ /lus kyi dus na 'di lta ste/ /'byung ba 'dus pa'i phung po yis/ /tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas su/ /ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i cha/ /stong gsal 'dus pa sku'i gdangs/ /zhal phyag rdzogs pa bum sku'i tshul/ /lhun grub 'od kyi gong bur gnos/ /thugs rje kha dog so sor gsal/ zhes bya ba la sags pa gsungs/ nar bu phra bkad las kyang / /nam mkhas gar khyab sems can te/ /rig pa'i don yang de tsam mo/ /de yang mtha' la thug med de/ /rang gi ngo bo cig tu gnas/ /ngo bo dus gsum 'gyur ba med/ /rang bzhin rtag tu 'gags pa med/ /thugs rjes kun la rab snang ngo / /zhes bya ba dang / klong drug pa las kyang / ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin dang / /thugs —29—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/rje pa yi snang bar yang / /blo can rnams la snang ba'o/ /ngo bo gang du ma grub pas/ /rang bzhin snang cha gsal bar snang / /thugs rje'i cha las ye shes gnyis/ /bya dang byed pa med par bshad/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar thog ma gzhi'i gnas lugs dang / da ltar sems can gyi rang rig pa'i gnas lugs la bzang ngan dang che chung med pas na/ dus gsum gcig ste khyad par med/ /zhes 'byung ngo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni rang byung rang shar/ rang grol yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhi'i lung rnams so so'i skabs su sbyar bar bya'o/ /de rtogs sangs rgyas ma byung / ma rtogs te sems can ma byung ba'i sngon rol gzhi dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs bstan to/ /da gnyis pa de las 'khrul pa ji ltar byung tshul bstan pa ni/ 'di las 'khor 'das gnyis rgyab gyes te/ kun tu bzang po'i dge ba rdul tsam cig ma byas par sangs rgyas pa dang / mkha' mnyam gyi sems can gyis sdig pa spu tsam cig ma byas par 'khor bar lhung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ thal 'gyur las/de ltar 'khor 'das thog mtha' las/ /sangs rgyas 'khrul par ma 'gyur pas/ /gzhi nas 'phags pa'i dbang po yis/ /rang snang rang bzhin med par shes/ /rtogs spyod yid rnams phyir ma shor/ /'gyu ba rang thog chod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rang snang ngo ma shes pas 'khrul te/ ji ltar 'khrul na/ gzhi dang gzhi shes kyi khyad par las zhakhrul te/ gzhi dang gzhi shes zhes bya ba khyab pa spyir stong pas gang du yang ma phye bas 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi rtsis med shes pa'i khyad par 'dod pa rang gzhung du bstan pas rig —30—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/pa'o/ /zhes pa'am/ ye shes so zhes pa de nyid 'khrul pas/ dper na dung dkar po la ser por mthong pa de nyid mig zhabrul pa yin no/ /zhes pa de rang zhabrul par song pa yin no/ /de nyid ma 'khrul ba yin no zhes pa de nyid 'khrul/ de ltar yang / gzhi ni gang yang byed med cing / /nges pa med pa tsam las so/ khres dang 'gyu dang yal ba dang / /mched pa 'dzin pa rnams yin no/ /spags pas dri ma 'dzin pa de/ khres bya rang rgyud bcings pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid rten 'brel bcu gnyis su zhabrul te/ dmigs 'dzin 'brel pa bcu gnyis su/ /'khor ba'i thog ma nyid du'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang rgyu ma rig pas 'khrul te/ 'khrul pa'i rgyu ni ma rig pa/ /ma rig pa ni rnam pa gsum/ /bdag nyid cig pas 'khrul rtsa byas/ /lhan cig skyes pas rtog pa gnyis/ /kun tu brtags pas yul du gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bye ma las/ rgyu zhes nges par bdag nyid cig /ma rig rnams kyi dang po ste/ /de las lhan cig skyes pa nyid/ /ye shes dag pa'i sdos phyir snang / /de las yul snang kun du brtags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thog ma'i gzhi ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum ma rig pa gsum du song ba ni/ ngo bos 'byul pa'i rgyu byas pas na ma rig pa zhes btags shing de nyid du song ba ni/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i rkyen byas pas 'phen pa las kyi rlung las kha dog du gsal bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa zhes btags shing de nyid du 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar ma rig rig rgyu cig pa lag pa'i lto rgyab ldog pa lta bur ma shes pa las rgyu bdag nyid cig pa'i ma rig par song ba ni don gyis gnyis med —31—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/du ma shes pa las rgyu bdag nyid cig pa'i ma rig par song ba ni don gyis gnyis med du ma shes pa las byung ba'o/ /de las lhan cig skyes pa zhes gnyis kyi sgra ste/ 'di ni ka dag yin no zhes nam byung rtsa na de dang dbyer med du yod pa'i rig pa la ltos pa'i ma rig pa/ ma 'khrul ba la ltos pas 'khrul pa/ de ltar rig pa nyid ma rig par song bas ma 'khrul ba nyid zhabrul par byung ba'o/ /de la yul can du 'dzin pa byung ba'o/ /kun du btags pa'i ma rig pa ni rkyen kun du rtog pa ste/ de yul las snang cha'i bye bral las/ /kun tu btags pa rkyen bzhi'i cha/ tāspyi dang bdag pos ngos bzung ste/ /dmigs pa nyid dang yul mtshungs pas/ /'dus shing bzung bas 'khrul zhes bya/ /zhes pas/ ma rig pa gsum po de 'dus pa dper na skyes bu'i byad 'dra bas 'khrul ba'i rgyu byas pas rgyu'i rkyen ma rig pa gsum mo/ /de las dmigs pa'i rgyu rkyen zhes yul dmigs pa so sor shar bas/ me long gi dkyil 'khor lta bu'o/ /de ltar me long gi nang du bzhin shar bas de gnyis las 'di ni me long de'i nang du shar ba ni bdag gi bzhin no/ /'dir shar ba 'di bzhin du bdag gi byad yod do snyam pa ni bdag po'i rkyen te/ nga dang bdag tu bzung dang 'dzin pa sna tshogs pa las nyon mongs pa dpag tu med par song ba'i/ de gsum du mtshungs pas de ma thag pa zhes don gyi ka dag du 'dod pas ma dag pa dngos su song ba ni dper na mi ming med du song ba lta bu'i de las yid drug du 'brul pa ni/ yi ge med pa las/ snang ba med pa thog ma dus kyi tshe/ /gcod byed phyogs pa'i yid drug ma 'gags pas/ zhes —32—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/pa dang / kun tu 'tshol byed kyi yid/ rten la gzhi 'bebs pa'i yid/ nges par 'jog pa'i yid/ 'gyu byed 'dzin pa'i yid/ sna tshogs bsdud pa'i yid/nyon mongs pa can gyi yid do/ /de las nyon mongs pa bdag chags dang kun gzhi'i rtog pa 'dzin pa'o/ /bdag grub zhabrul pa'i rgyud bzhir 'gyur zhes yul dang yul can du bzung ba dang / 'dzin pa las phyi snod nang bcud du chags te/ de dag ji ltar chags ba'i tshul/ thal 'gyur le'u dang po'i stod nas rgyas par byung ngo/ /mu tig phreng ba las kyang / phyi sa 'khrul gzhi zhes bya ste/ /ma rig pa nyid sbags pa'i phyir/ /shes bya nyid kyi dri mar snang / /sems la dran bsam 'char ba'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid ni rtog pas sbags/ /'od gsal nyid kyang bag la chags/ /rkyen bzhi dmigs pa ma dag phyir/ /yid drug 'dzin cha ma 'gags phyir/ /chos sku nyid kyang bzung bas bcings cha med rdul dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /snang ba nyid kyang du ma shar/ /snang ba de nyid yul snang phyir/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de phyi snod kyi 'jig rten ji ltar chags pa'ang /de nyid las mkha' la rlung brten de la chu/ /'bum phrag bcu gcig dag gis ni/ /zlum la 'dril ba nyid du chags/ /zhes bya ba dang / de ltar gnas pa'ang /ri rab rgyal po ni/ bang rim bzhi dang lcog chen dang / rol mtsho dang ni ri rnams bdun/ /gling rnams dang ni 'khor yug chags/ /stong gsum la sogs khams rnams so/ /de la brten pa'i nang bcud kyi sems can/ 'dod dang gzugs dang gzugs med kyi/ khams gsum po ni de la brten/ /yod min ci yang med pa dang / /rnam shes cud zad med pa yi/ /gzugs med —33—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhad mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/rnams ni de las skyes/ /gnas gtsang la sogs lus can ni/ /gong nas gong du theg pa'i tshul/ /'og min la sogs 'dod pa'o/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams ni/ /mngon par mthong dang de gsum ni/ /byol song yi dwags dmyal ba dang / /sems can de dag skye ba bzhi/ /de ltar 'jig rten gsum po lnga/ /yan lag lnga dang don snying lnga/ /yul lnga dang ni nyon mongs lnga/ /sems lnga yid lnga rtog pa lnga/ /gzugs 'dzin 'khor ba nyid du grub/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /bzung 'dzin dbang gis bzung nas ni/ /'khor ba nyid la yun ring gnas/ khams gsum pa yi khang pa mā /ming dang gzugs kyi brtson rar tshud/ /ma rig la sogs lcags kyis ldems/ /'khor ba'i mun nag stug pos g.yogs/ /'dod chags tsha ba'i ro la chags/ /gti mug zhags pas ske nas bcings/ /zhe sdang me'i tshad pas gdung/ /nga rgyal dbang gis mgo btums te/ /phrag dog nyid kyi sgo mo 'khrigs/ khong khro la sogs dmag gis bskor/ /gzung 'dzin zhags pas rke nas btags/ /snga phyi bag chags 'dam du bying / /rnam smin nyid dang lag sbrel te/ /las kyi ma bus mtshams sbyar nas/ /gcig nas gcig tu chu bzhin rgyu/ /bzang ngan rim pas lus blangs te/ /so so'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur/ /ngar 'dzin rab la 'bogs nas ni/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i 'dam du bying / /ngan song lcags kyus snying nas bzung / /rang gis rang bcings nyon mongs dgra/ /dmyal ba me dang chu ltar snang / /yi dwags rnams la bred sdug gis/ /byol song rnams la na bun ltar/ /mi rnams phung po khamasadang ni/ /skye mched 'byung ba lnga ru —34—

rdzogs pa po tshig don bcu gcig pa/snang / /de yang bde sdug gtang snyoms so/ /lha min rnams la go mtshon te/ /lha rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan no/ /dper na myur 'gro 'khor lo bzhin/ /rgyun chags 'khor ba yun ring gnas/ /de ltar snang ba sna tshogs rnams/ /thag pa la ni sbrul mthong bzhin/ /de ma yin la der bzung pas/ /phyi nang snod bcud gnyis su chags/ /de yang brtags na thag pa nyid/ /don dam kun rdzob gzugs can no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyud gzhan las kyang /'khrul lugs ci rigs par gsungs so/ /des 'khrul pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bstan to/ /da ni gsum pa 'khrul ba'i sems can la sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'am sa bon ji ltar gnas par bstan pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying pos sems can thams cad la til 'bru la mar gyis khyab pa bzhin du khyab bo/ /zhes pas/ thal 'gyur las/ rang rig ye shes lus la gnas/ /til 'bru la ni mar bzhin du/ /lus kyi bkrag dang gzi mdangs ni/ /ye shes sman gyis khyab par byed/ zhes pa rig pa rang gsal las/ yang dag sangs rgyas dgongs pa ni/ /sems can kun gyi rang rgyud la/ /sku dang ye shes tshul du gnas/ zhes bya ba dang / nor bu phra bkod las/ til 'bru'am ni yungs 'bru la/ /mar nyid ye nas lhun grub bzhin/ /sems can lus ltar snang ba la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa bon ni/ /mthun pa'i 'od dang bcas par snang / /zhes gsungs pas/ sems can rnams rang bzhin lhun grub kyi ye shes zhes bya ste/ lus rang bzhin lhun grub kyi sangasargyas yin pas/ 'gro ba'i lus la —35—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/sku lnga/ ye shes lnga/ rigs sna lnga/ 'dod sna lnga/ rlung sna lnga/ shes rab la sogs pa lnga tshan du+o gnas so/ /de ltar gnas pa'i rtagaso su ma dag po'i snang ba la/ phung pa lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ dbang pa lnga/ 'dad yan lnga/ nyan mongs pa lnga la sogs pa lnga tshan du snang ba'o/ /de nyid kyang ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i snang ba yin te/ thal 'gyur las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas pas/ /gzhan du gnas pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / phung po sangs rgyas mnga' bdag tu zhes gsungs/ rang shar las/ 'gro ba'i phung po sangs rgyas sku/ /zhes pa de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mu tig phreng ba las kyang / phung po khams dang skye mched kun/ /rigs dang rigs kyi bdag por grol/ /zhes 'byung te/gang na/ rtsal rdzogs las/ /nyon mongs lnga las ye shes lnga/ /yul lnga las ni 'od lnga sku/ /phung po lnga las sangs rgyas lnga/ /'byung ba lnga las yum lnga rtogs/ /srid pa gsum nyid sangs rgyas zhing / /gnyis med lta bu'i rang lus yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang rang shar las/ de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po'i don/ /rang rang lus la rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ye shes rngam klog las/ rang g.yin lhun grub zab mo'i don/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang gzhan dag pas dri ma med/ /phung po lnga don sangs rgyas lnga/ /'byung ba lnga don dbyings phyug yum/ khams dang skye mched mang po kun/ /sems dpa' sems ma'i dkyil 'khor yin/ /de nyid srid gsum dkyil 'khor che/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bla mas gzugs kyi phung po rnam snang yin la sogs pa rgyas pa bshad par bya'o/ /sems rang bzhin lhun grub kyi sangs —36—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/rgyas su bstan pa ni/ de ltar sku dang ye shes rnams rang rig pa'i ngo bo la rdzogs par bstan pa ni/ thal 'gyur las/ ye shes lnga dang sku lnga ste/ /rlung lnga shes pa'i rtsal yang lnga/ /thams cad lnga lnga'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mu tig phreng ba las/ de ltar snying po de nyid las/ /sku lnga ye shes lnga dang ni/ /'od lnga kha dog rnam pa lnga/ khres rab lnga dang rlung nyid lnga/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rig pa'i ye shes lnga tshan du gnas te/ sku sna lnga/rigs sna lnga/ ye shes lnga/ 'od lnga/ rlud sna lnga/ shes rab sna lnga gnas so/ /de la rig pa'i ye shes sku lngar gnas pa ni/ rig pa'i ye shes de nyid rnam par snang mdzad du gnas te/ snang ba yul de nyid rig pa'i ye shes su snang bas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur byung bas de nyid gzhan nas btsal mi dgos pas/ tshig chad pa'i nad dang bral ba'o/ /rang rig pa'i ye shes de la nyams kyi ngo bo 'phel snang la sogs pa yon tan gyi sgo mang po bstan pas na/rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sku ltar du byung ste/ dper na/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la dgos 'dod gang bsam gsol ba btab pas 'byung ba ltar/rang rig las kyang mtho ris ngan song gang 'dod da lta'i las la brten nas 'byung ba'o/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pas yi dam gzhan sgom mi dgos pa'i gnad do/ /yang rig pa nyid bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas nyams su blangs/'od kyi snang ba mtha' yas par snang bas na/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku ltar yang 'byung ste/ gzhan du btsal mi dgos par rang rig pa'i ye shes de nyid sangs rgyas pa'i don sa bon gyi tshul du yod pas de nyams su blangs pas na/—37—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhad mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/don yod grub pa'i sku ltar du byung bas gzhan du btsal mi dgos so/ /de nyid rigs ltar yang gnas te/ sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams gshegs shul du rig pa gshegs pas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yin la/ de nyid mtho ris ngan song gang na gnas kyang /ngo bo la bzang ngan nam che chung 'gyur ldog med pas rdo rje'i rigs yin la de nyid skyon med pas yon tan rang rdzogs su yod pas rin po che'i rigs su gnas la/ de nyid 'khor ba na gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pas na pad+ma'i rigs su gnas la/de nyid las bsag pa la brten nas sangs rgya bas na las kyi rigs su gnas so/ /yang rig pa nyid ye shes lngar gnas pa ni/ rig pa nyid la chos spyi dang rang gi gzugs brnyan gsal bas me long lta bu'i ye shes/ rig pa nyid mnyam rgyu la mnyam rkyen bla ma'i gdams ngag gis byas mnyam pa'i 'bras bu tshad la pheb sam bar dor mnyam pas na mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/de ltar mnyam pa nyid du gnas kyang sems can gyi blo yi bye brag tha dad pa'i phyir na rig pa nyid so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de yang bka' thub la sogs pa 'bad rtsol chen po la rag ma lus pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de rnams kyang tha dad ma yin te chos kyi dbyings stong nyid du ro gcig pa'i phyir na chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /rig pa nyid 'od lnga ltar yang 'byung ste/ rig pa nyid la/ las dang nyon mongs pa gang gis kyang ma gos pas dkar po ltar yang 'byung / yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir ser po ma btsal bzhag pa'i phyir dbang rdzogs phyir dmar po ltar yang 'byung / de la rtsol ba —38—

rdzogasapa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/las 'das pa'i phyir ljang khu/ de ltar rig pa nyid sna tshogs su shar yang / ngo bo gcig las 'gyur ba med pas kha dog mthing ka ltar yang shar ro/ /rig pa nyid rlung ltar yang 'byung ste/ rig pa ye shes kyi rgyas 'debs pa'i phyir na/me dang mnyam pa'i rlung zhes kyang bya/ 'khor ba dang 'das pa'i srog 'dzin pas na/ srog 'dzin pa'i rlung zhes kyang bya'o/ /ye shes kyi dwangs snyigs sgron ma dang skur byed pas na/ 'byung ba dwangs snyigs kyi don dam dang kun rdzob tu byed pa dang / dbang po dang lus kha dog du byed pas na dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i rlung ngo / /'khor 'das thams cad la khyab pas na khyab byed kyi rlung /'khor ba'i srog bcad nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sar 'phen pas na/ snying rje med pa skal ba las kyi rlung zhes bya'o/ /rig pa nyid shes rab lnga ltar yang gnas te/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi 'byung gzhir byung bas na/ 'byed par byed pa'i shes rab du gnas te/ de nyid rang rig pas gsal ba'i ngo bo gang la yang ma grub pas/ bsdud par byed pa'i shes rab du gnas so/ /de nyid thams cad kyi ngo bor byung bas na khyab par byed pa'i shes rab du gnas la/'khor 'das gnyis ka'i srog gcod pas na sgrol byed kyi shes rab du gnas so/ /de ltar rig pa las ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas na rang byung gi ye shes zhes bya'o/ /de yang sku 'od ye shes gsum brtsegs su gnas te/ ngo bo'i cha skur gnas pas na mnyam bzhag gi dus sku nyid du gnas la/ mnyam rjes gang du yang ma phye ba'i dus na longs sku'i nyid las/ rjes kyi dus na sprul pa'i sku'o/ /de ltar du rig pa rang shar las/ rig pa rtog pa med pa —39—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/chos kyi sku/ /rig pa 'gag med gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /rig pa cir yang gsal ba sprul pa'i sku'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang gzhan 'od gsal du gnas pa gzhi la nang gsal gnas/ 'bras bu sgron mar gsal ba 'og nas ston/ thugs rje'i cha ye shes su gnas pa'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas lugs gsum po de dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor gnas te/ klong drug pa las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /ye rdzogs rang gi lus la gnas/ /zhes pa dang / mu tig phreng ba las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /zhes mdor bstan nas rgyas par chos sku longs sku sprul sku dang / mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /zhes pa dang / 'das pa dkar po'i chos rnams ni/ /lus dang sems la thams cad rdzogs/ /de nyid rdzogs phyir gnas pa ni/ /btsal bas rnyed pa'i gnas med do/ /zhes gsungs/ snang ba rang bzhin lhun grub ni/ 'di ltar snang grags kyi chos thams cad kyang rnal 'byor pa'i lus dang sems la tshang bar yang /rgyud de nyid las/ sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /nam mkha' dang ni nyi zla dang / /skyes pa bud med dag gi gzugs/ /gza' dang skar ma sprin dang ni/ khreng dang ri dang brag rnams dang / /rtswa ba sdong po yal ga dang / /'dab ma me tog 'bras bu dang / /dri dang ro dang sgra dang reg /rol mo rnams dang 'phan gdugs dang / /rgyal mtshan dang ni bla bre dang / /de dag 'khor te snang ba'i chos/ /rnal 'byor nyid kyi lus la tshang / /sa ni sha ste dngos po nyid/ /chu ni khrag ste sdud pa nyid/ /me ni drod de lus sku smin/ /rlung ni dbugs te —40—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/lus kun 'dzin/ /nam mkha' sems te lus dang 'brel/ /nyi zla mig ste gsal bar byed/ /zhes bya ba nas/ rnal 'byor lus la de dag rdzogs/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /rig pa nyid la 'di lta ste/ /'byung ba lnga ni 'od lnga ste/ /nyi ma zla ba shes rab thabs/ /zhes pa nas/ sems nyid ngo la chos rnams ni/ /ye nas lhun grub tshul du gnas/ /zhes pa'i bar du gsungs so/ /de dag kyang phyi rol snang ba la tshang pas/ lus dang sems la tshang / yang lus dang sems la tshang bas/ /lus dang snang ba la tshang ngo / /'di dag kyang gzhi ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ma tshang na rnal 'byor ba'i sems dang lus dang snang ba la ci ma tshang ste/ gzhi la tshang bas de ltar tshang bar 'byung ba'o/ /de 'khor 'das thams cad dbyer med du rtogs pa'i phyir/ dpal kye'i rdo rje las/ 'khor nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'di ltar khams gsum 'khor bar yang / /sangs mi rgya ba cig kyang med/ /ces gosungs so/ /de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi gzhi'am sa bon ji ltar gnas tshul ta/ /da ni bzhi pa de lta bu'i rig pa'i ye shes de gnas pa gang la gnas bstan pa ni/ gnas pa dang / gnas lugs dang / ji ltar gnas pa'i dpa' bo/ dang po lus kyi dkyil tsit+ta rin po che'i gzhal yas khang na gnas te/thal 'gyur las/ tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas su/ /rin chen 'dus pa'i zur brgyad sgo/ /zhes pa'ang spyi dang tsit+ta rtsa'i nang / ma bcos dag pa'i chos nyid —41—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhang mkhasapa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/gnas/ /zhes bya ba dang / ngo sprod sprasapa las kyang / don ni rang gi lus dkyil na/ /snying nang ye shes chen por gnas/ /zhes bya ba dang / nor bu phra bkod las kyang / rin chen zur brgyad gzhal yas dang / /'gyu byed rtsa'i gzhal yas dang / /dung khang bhan+ta'i gzhal yas dang / /lta byed mig gi gzhal yas so/ /gzhal yas chen po de bzhi na/ /gsang sngags kun gyi gsang chen gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid na rig pa ye shes kyi gnas ni/ ngo bo skur gnas pa/ rang bzhin thugs rjer gnas pa/ thugs rje ye shes sgron mar gnas te/ dang po ni snying kha na zhi ba'i sku/ de'i rtsal dung khang na khro bo'i sku gnas so/ /de yang thal 'gyur las/ sems can kun gyi lus spyi la/ /chos nyid rlung gi tshul gyis khyab/ /'phra dang yang dag 'gyu dang 'byed/ / tsit+ta'i nang na sku gnas te/ /gdangs kyi sku ni rnam pa lngas/ /so so rigs kyi mtshan nyid 'dzin/ zhes pa dang / rtsal rdzogs las/ gsang 'dus rin chen zur brgyad mdzod/ /rig pa'i ye shes yab yum tshul/ /srog 'dus rin chen zur bzhi'i mdzod/ /rig pa'i ye shes thig ler gnas/ /dung 'khyil bhan+ta'i gzhal yas mdzod/ /rig pa'i ye shes khro skur gnas/ /'gag med gsal ba'i sgo gnyis mdzod/ /dbyings dang lu gu rgyud du gnas/zhes pa dang / nor bu phra bkod las/ e ma rig pa'i gnas lugs ni/ /rang rang tsit+ta'i dkyil na gnas/ /yab yum gnyis kyi tshul du gnas/ /yab kyi cha 'dzin shes rab sku/ /'od dang 'od zer tshul du gnas/ /de ni zhi ba'i bzhugs tshul lo/ /rang rang mgo la khro bor gnas/ /yab dang yum du mngon —42—

rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa/par snang / khro dang khro ba'i tshul 'chang zhing / /ye shes lnga lnga dag dang ldan/zhes pa dang / rang bzhin 'od kyi thig le ni/ /rtsa rnams nang na thig le'i sku ltar snang / /che ba'i tshad ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /chung ba'i tshad ni rta rnga bcur gshag tsam/ /gsal ba'i tshad ni nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /de yang gsal 'tsher gzi brjid 'bar/ /'gro dang 'ong dang gnas pa'o/ /gsung thugs rje sgron mar gnas pa'o/ /thugs rje 'byung ba nyi zer sgron ma bzhin/ /sgron ma'i 'od zer stong la thug pa med/ /gnas pa'i 'od ni tsit+ta'i nang du gsal/ /rang bzhin 'od ni nam mkha'i mthong nas gsal/ /zhes pa dang rang shar las/ thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang / khres rab rang byung sgron ma dang / /rgyang zhag chu'i sgron ma ni/ /sems can kun la gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ji ltar gnas pa de bstan pa ni/ de yang ngo bo skur gnas pas sku thams cad bum pa'i sku ltar gnas so/ /rang bzhin 'od gnas te/ bum pa'i nang gi mar me lta bur gnas so/ /thugs rje zer du gnas pas ye shes sgron ma'i gdangs ma 'gag par gsal lo/ /de skad du yang thal 'gyur las/tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas na/ /ngo bo ka nas dag pa'i cha/ /stong gsal 'dus pa sku'i gdangs/ /zhal phyag rdzogs pa bum sku'i tshul/ /lhun grub 'od kyi gong bur gnas/ /thugs rje kha dog so sor gsal/ /zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon bye ma las/ sku ni nang gsal bum sku ltar/ /'od ni bum pa'i mar me bzhin/ /ye shes rma bya'i sgo nga 'dra/ zhes gsungs so/ /sku yungs 'bru tsam la spyan phul dag tsam zer ba ni/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i khyad par dgos pa'o/ /—43—

mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ shad mkhas pa nyi 'bum gyi gsung chos skor/la las ye shes 'pho zhing gnas par bshad nas 'dug ste/ 'pho ba ni rlung gi 'phar bzhib yin no/ /'phos nas lus sems bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhis gnas pa bstan pa'o/ /da ni lnga pa de ltar gnas pa'i ye shes lam gang nas byung bstan pa ni/thal 'gyur las/ rig pa'i ye shes lam nyid ni/ /rang gi rtsa'i 'khor lo nas/ /sku gsum rang rdzags gnas pa las/ /ra ma rkyang ma sku dhar ma/ /rtsa gsum dag gis lus bzung ste/ /dbu mas 'khor lo bzhi rten bcas/ /'di dag g.yas g.yon la gnas pas/ /kun rdzob don dam dbye ba yis/ /lus dang yan lag skyod pa dang / /sgron ma nyid kyang smin par byed/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar rtsa'i mtshan nyid shes par byed pa la/ lus kyi mtshan nyid shes dgos te/ dang po chags pa'i mtshan nyid ma shes na/ bar du gnas pa'i mtshan nyid mi shes/ de ma shes na tha ma lus 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid mi shes/de ltar lus kyi mtshan nyid ma shes na rtsa'i mtshan nyid mi shes pas/ dang po lus chags pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ skye ba snga ma 'das nas/ bar do yid kyi lus can blangs te/ shes pa chad chod yam yam du gnas pa las/ tshangs pa spyod pa'i mngal gyi sgor sngon gyi las kyi dbang gis rnal 'byor gyi sha la sbrang bu 'phur ba ltar 'phungs te/ la la'i srog chad pa ltar snang / de nas bzang ngan gyi dbang gis mngal gyi skye gnas su bshad pa'i lam nas zhugs te/ mngal gyi rgyar mthums nas/ bdag lus len pa po'i rlung sems dang pha ma'i rgyu rkyen gnyis de gzhi khrag dang 'o ma 'dres pa las rgyu rkyen gnyis las kun —44—
